reference.citation: Kwiatkowski D, Phillips PCB, Schmidt P, Shin Y (1992). Testing the null hypothesis of stationarity... J Econometrics 54:159-178. Reference impl: statsmodels.tsa.stattools.kpss / adfuller (Seabold & Perktold 2010). Data: eegmmidb, PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the KPSS statistic with statsmodels.tsa.stattools.kpss(regression='c') on the identical signal; reports the statistic, the bit-exact agreement, statsmodels' 5% critical value, whether KPSS fails to reject stationarity, whether ADF rejects the unit root, and whether the two tests agree
